messages.content: I need to start planning Minneapolis for my niece’s graduation. The ceremony is Sunday afternoon, and my wife and I would leave Atlanta Friday after work and come home Monday. Please compare the flights and hotels together, not as separate lists.

What weekend is the graduation, and where are the Sunday ceremony and Saturday family gathering? I’ll compare round-trip airfare for two with one shared room for Friday through Monday and include travel time to both events.

Friday, May 15 through Monday, May 18. The ceremony is at 2:00 Sunday at 3M Arena at Mariucci. Saturday dinner is at my sister’s house in Edina near 50th and France, probably at 6:00. We can rent a car if that makes the locations easier.

Thanks. For Friday, what is the earliest you can reach ATL, and on Monday is there a time you need to be back in Atlanta? Also, should I include the rental car in the package totals or just use it when estimating drive times?

We can be at the airport by 5:15 Friday, so departures from about 6:45 onward are realistic. Monday is open, but I would rather not land after 8:00 p.m. Include a compact rental car from MSP for the whole trip. One room for two adults, three nights.

I found two workable nonstop flight pairings. The lower-cost pairing is Sun Country: Friday at 7:35 p.m., arriving MSP at 9:18 p.m.; Monday at 1:25 p.m., arriving ATL at 4:58 p.m. The fare is $638 round trip for two before seat or checked-bag charges. The more flexible pairing is Delta: Friday at 6:55 p.m., arriving at 8:38 p.m.; Monday at 3:10 p.m., arriving at 6:43 p.m. That is $826 for two in Main Cabin. A compact car picked up and returned at MSP is currently $236 including estimated taxes and facility fees. Do you expect to check luggage? That changes the meaningful flight total.
One checked suitcase between us. We can each carry on a smaller bag. Please use the actual trip cost with that one suitcase and any seat fees needed for us to sit together.

With one checked bag each direction and standard adjacent-seat selections, the Sun Country estimate rises to $798 for two. Delta comes to $896 for two after one checked bag each way; standard seat selection is included in the quoted Main Cabin fare. The compact car remains $236, so flight plus car is $1,034 with Sun Country or $1,132 with Delta. I’ll now pair each with hotels near the arena and near 50th and France. Is there a hotel budget or rating floor for this trip?

Try to keep the whole trip under $1,800, including flights, car, room, taxes, and mandatory fees. I do not need luxury, but I do not want something poorly reviewed. Show me the best complete combinations even if one goes a little over.

Three hotel candidates fit the geography. Graduate by Hilton Minneapolis is near the university campus, about a 6-minute drive or roughly a 12-minute walk to the arena; a king room for three nights is $612 including taxes. From there, Saturday dinner near 50th and France is about 22-30 minutes by car. The Westin Edina Galleria is about 8-12 minutes from dinner and 25-35 minutes from the arena; a traditional king totals $684. Home2 Suites Minneapolis University Area is about 8 minutes by car from the arena and 24-32 minutes from dinner; a king studio totals $498 with taxes and required fees.
The university Home2 Suites sounds practical, but compare it directly with the Westin. I want to see the schedule consequences, not just the dollar difference.

Sun Country plus Home2 Suites and the compact car totals about $1,532. You would land Friday at 9:18 p.m.; allowing for the rental counter and drive, hotel arrival would be around 10:15-10:40. For Saturday dinner, leaving at 5:15 should provide a reasonable cushion for the 24-32 minute drive and parking. On Sunday, leaving around 12:55 gives time for the short drive, event traffic, parking, and reaching your seats before 2:00. Monday’s 1:25 flight means leaving the hotel about 10:35 to refuel, return the car, and clear security.

Delta plus the Westin totals about $1,816. You would reach MSP at 8:38 Friday and likely arrive at the hotel around 9:35-10:00. Saturday dinner is close enough that leaving around 5:30 should be comfortable. For Sunday, I would leave the Westin by 12:35 because the normal 25-35 minute drive can lengthen around the university before a ceremony. Monday’s 3:10 flight permits a hotel departure around 12:15. The Westin package is $284 more and $16 over your target, but it gives you an earlier Friday arrival, a later Monday departure, and much easier access to Saturday dinner.
You paired the cheaper flight with the cheaper hotel and the expensive flight with the expensive hotel. Cross-pair them too so I can tell which part is worth paying for.

Here are all four combinations, including two round-trip tickets, one checked suitcase each way, adjacent standard seats where separately charged, one compact rental car, and one room for three nights: Sun Country plus Home2 Suites, $1,532; Delta plus Home2 Suites, $1,630; Sun Country plus Westin Edina, $1,718; Delta plus Westin Edina, $1,816. The $98 flight upgrade buys an arrival 40 minutes earlier Friday and a departure 1 hour 45 minutes later Monday. The $186 hotel upgrade mainly shifts convenience toward Saturday: dinner becomes an 8-12 minute drive instead of 24-32 minutes, while the Sunday ceremony becomes a 25-35 minute drive instead of about 8 minutes.
That makes the Home2 Suites clearer. Is there any issue with getting to dinner from there on Saturday around that time? I know Minneapolis traffic can change the estimate.

The main variable is traffic through south Minneapolis and around the lakes. A normal estimate is 24-32 minutes, but I would allow 40 minutes on Saturday evening and leave by 5:10 for a 6:00 dinner. That leaves room for a slower segment or finding parking near 50th and France. Returning later in the evening should generally be quicker. The hotel’s location is substantially better for Sunday, when arena traffic and parking are the more time-sensitive part of the weekend.
Can you check whether the Home2 rate includes parking? Also make sure the room is one king, not two beds. We only need one room.

The quoted $498 total is for one king studio for two adults, Friday through Monday. Breakfast is included. Self-parking is currently listed at $25 per night plus tax and was not included in the first hotel figure. Adding three nights of parking brings the lodging estimate to $579 and changes the four package totals to $1,613 for Sun Country plus Home2, $1,711 for Delta plus Home2, $1,718 for Sun Country plus Westin, and $1,816 for Delta plus Westin. The Westin quote includes self-parking, which is why those totals do not change.
Interesting. So the Sun Country and Westin combination is only seven dollars more than Delta and Home2. Put those two side by side, including what happens Monday morning.

Sun Country plus Westin is about $1,718. Friday arrival is 9:18 p.m., with likely hotel arrival around 10:15-10:40. Saturday dinner is an 8-12 minute drive. Sunday requires the longer 25-35 minute trip to the arena, so a 12:35 departure is prudent. On Monday, the 1:25 p.m. flight means checking out and leaving around 10:20 to refuel and return the car.

Delta plus Home2 is about $1,711. Friday arrival is 8:38 p.m., with likely hotel arrival around 9:35-10:00. Saturday dinner is 24-32 minutes away, so leave around 5:10. Sunday’s arena trip is about 8 minutes, and leaving around 12:55 should provide ample event cushion. The 3:10 p.m. Monday flight lets you leave the hotel around noon. For seven dollars less, Delta plus Home2 gives you the better flight schedule and easier ceremony access; the tradeoff is the longer Saturday dinner drive and paid hotel parking already included in the total.
Delta with Home2 is the strongest one. Before I decide, are the flight and hotel cancellable, and is the car price prepaid?

The quoted Delta Main Cabin tickets can be canceled before departure for eCredit rather than a cash refund; the checked-bag charge would be paid at travel time. Home2’s quoted rate can be canceled without charge until 11:59 p.m. local hotel time on May 13, after which one night plus tax is charged. The compact-car estimate is pay at pickup, with free cancellation before the scheduled pickup time and no prepayment. The current $1,711 package estimate can still move because airfare, room inventory, and rental taxes are not locked until reservation.

Do not book anything yet. Give me a concise recommendation with the exact flights, full estimated total, hotel location logic, and the departure times we should use for both family events. I need to send it to my wife first.

Recommended plan: Delta nonstop for two, departing Atlanta Friday, May 15 at 6:55 p.m. and arriving Minneapolis-St. Paul at 8:38 p.m.; return Monday, May 18 at 3:10 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 6:43 p.m. Pair it with one king studio for two adults at Home2 Suites Minneapolis University Area for three nights and a compact car at MSP. The estimated all-in total is $1,711: $896 for flights with one checked suitcase round trip, $579 for the room including three nights of self-parking, and $236 for the rental car. The hotel is about 8 minutes by car from Sunday’s 2:00 p.m. ceremony and about 24-32 minutes from Saturday dinner near 50th and France. Leave the hotel at 5:10 p.m. Saturday for the 6:00 dinner and at 12:55 p.m. Sunday for the ceremony. On Monday, plan to leave around noon for the 3:10 flight. The hotel is cancelable through 11:59 p.m. local time May 13; Delta cancellation returns an eCredit, and the car is pay at pickup with cancellation before pickup. Nothing has been held or booked.
